name: Kawakami Hanamaru
source:
Hanamaru is from the east and, for some reason, ran an orphanage. Although he has a languid personality, he took good care of the children. He insists that he's talented at swordsmanship, but that he doesn't practice it in secret...

[Translated from [url=https://www.devilbutler.com/%E3%83%8F%E3%83%8A%E3%83%9E%E3%83%AB]official website[/url]]
